text: Triggers can automatically draft replies when emails arrive, add team comments, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ apps
quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.

text: The AI can browse the web for the latest information related to your emails
quote: Allow the AI to browse the web to get the latest information related to your emails

text: AI web browsing is turned on by default for paid plans
quote: AI web browsing enabled by default: Now automatically on for paid plans

text: Users can add custom integrations by pointing the AI at any MCP server, or build their own
quote: You can connect virtually any application through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Just click "Add custom integration" and point to an MCP server of your choice — or even create your own.

text: The AI Assistant connects to business apps like Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, and HubSpot to run workflows from the inbox
quote: Connect the AI to your Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, Hubspot, and more so you can automate workflows without ever leaving your inbox.

text: A Zapier integration connects the AI to thousands of other services
quote: Zapier: Connect to thousands of other services

text: A GitHub integration lets the AI check repositories and manage issues
quote: GitHub: Check repositories and manage issues

text: AI Snippets let you define an email template once and reuse it whenever needed
quote: AI Snippets let you define an email template once upfront and then re-use it whenever you need it.

text: AI Snippets can be used individually or shared across a team
quote: AI Snippets are available both for individual use and for use across your team.

text: Snippets support {AI placeholders} that the AI fills in automatically from instructions
quote: You just need to add instructions using `{AI placeholders}` and the AI will automatically fill them out.

text: Scheduled send lets you write a message and set it to send at a future time
quote: Scheduled send gives you the ability to send an email at a future time. All you have to do is write a message, set a send time, and then move on to your next task.

text: The send scheduler accepts natural-language times
quote: Shortwave's scheduler uses the power of natural language to give you maximum control over when your email gets sent.

text: Undo send reverts an accidentally sent message back to a draft
quote: Undo send staves off the panic you feel when you accidentally send a message that wasn't ready by allowing you to revert a sent message back to a draft.

text: Splits divide the inbox into multiple focused inboxes, each in its own tab, so different email types can be handled at different times
quote: They’re a simple way to divide your one big inbox into multiple smaller, more focused inboxes – each in its own tab.

text: Splits can be defined by importance, built-in or custom labels, specific senders, or complex search queries
quote: You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries

text: Team comments let you privately discuss an email with teammates inside Shortwave
quote: Team comments let you privately discuss an email with your team directly in Shortwave, so you can plan how to respond together

text: @mentioning a teammate in a comment gives them access to both the comment and the email
quote: Something special happens when you `@mention` a teammate in a comment – they suddenly get access to not just your comment, but the email too

text: The AI Assistant can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, and check your calendar
quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more

text: Tab-to-complete AI suggestions appear while drafting, based on your previous emails so they sound like you
quote: Just press 'tab' to complete. These AI suggestions are intelligent and based on previous emails you've written, so they sound just like you

text: The AI learns your voice and style from emails you send so it can write emails that match
quote: Our AI learns your unique voice and style from the emails you send, so it can write emails that

text: Instant Summaries appear at the top of email threads as soon as you open them
quote: Instant Summaries show up at the very top of your email threads the instant you open them.

text: Instant Summaries are available on desktop, iOS, and Android for all users, including the free plan
quote: Instant Summaries are available on ALL platforms (Desktop, iOS, and Android) for ALL our users. That's right, even if you're on our free plan.

text: Custom AI filters automatically label, star, archive, and more, using rules written in plain English
quote: Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.

text: One click identifies important emails and todos and sweeps away the rest
quote: Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.

text: A Tasklet integration acts on emails automatically, and the resulting drafts appear in Shortwave
quote: Shortwave now integrates with Tasklet to take action on your emails automatically. Drafts appear right in Shortwave—not buried in Gmail.

quote: Choose between Basic (Claude Haiku 4.5), Standard (Claude Sonnet 4.6), Advanced (Claude Sonnet 4.6 with adaptive thinking), and Expert (Claude Opus 4.6 with adaptive thinking) intelligence levels
